messages.body: Kickoff: auth moves to the new token API today. Claim before you edit.
Take src/auth/: swap the session cookie for the token API.
CI on main is red since a1b2c3; hold merges until test_login passes.
Keep the refresh path. Tokens live 7 days and refresh rotates them.

Refresh path done, tests green.
Branch ws-auth, sha 4f2e9c1.
Is the 401 body part of the contract, or can it change?
Plain text for now. A test will pin it once the spec says otherwise, and the handler returns the same body for every 401.
Next: the token endpoint in src/auth/token.py once the spec lands. I will review the diff.
Which signing algorithm should the tokens use? The spec draft says RS256, the old service used HS256, and the fixtures need one answer before I write them.
